```lean
Projectivization.Subspace.span_eq_span_iff.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
  [Module K V] {S T : Set (ℙ K V)} : span S = span T ↔ S ⊆ ↑(span T) ∧ T ⊆ ↑(span S)
```
***
The spans of two sets of points in a projective space are equal if and only if each set of
points is contained in the span of the other set.
